purpose: Machine-readable registry of FALSIFIED research directions. Any preregistration whose mechanism section claims one of these without new data or a new mechanism argument is NOT ADMITTED (fail-closed).
usage: python Tools/banned_direction_gate.py --prereg <path>  -> exit 0 ADMIT, exit 1 REJECT (fail-closed)
exception_clause: A rejected direction may be re-admitted ONLY with (a) new data the original falsification lacked, or (b) a NEW mechanism argument not covered by the original falsification. The prereg must state which, and cite the original falsification id.

directions.name: ETF cross-sectional momentum
directions.reason: cross-section too narrow; A-share chasing strength has negative expectancy

directions.name: ETF cross-sectional reversal
directions.measured: annual -2.81%, max drawdown -28.7%; with no-trade band -2.05% and turnover rose to 20.6x
directions.reason: narrow cross-section only shuffles noise; cost exceeds signal

directions.name: Single-name timing reversal or momentum at 5/10/20 days
directions.measured: annual -2.7% to +2.8%, win rate 45-51% across the full grid (18 combinations)
directions.reason: no positive expectancy on ETFs after cost at short horizons

directions.name: Grid trading
directions.measured: SSE50 +11.9% excess but gold ETF opportunity cost -142.0%; securities ETF -9.2%
directions.reason: grid sells volatility and loses trends; target selection is the whole problem

directions.name: Market-temperature / breadth timing as a precondition
directions.measured: all worse than no precondition: base 14.80% -> 3.46% (breadth>0.5) / 5.18% (breadth>0.3) / 6.92% (EW>MA200); 58.1% idle
directions.reason: the low-amount signal is contrarian; any confirmation filter deletes it

directions.name: Stock-level confirmation preconditions (above MA20, prior 20d positive)
directions.reason: confirmation is the same action as deleting the signal

directions.name: Small-cap / low-price factor
directions.measured: 26.80% at >=50m ADV collapses to 0.80% at >=1bn and 0.40% at >=2bn
directions.reason: artefact of small-cap plus survivorship; the panel contains zero delisted names

directions.name: Buffer zones / trade bands used to cut turnover
directions.measured: buffer+10 held 14.87% but turnover stayed 29.7x; buffer+20 collapsed to 10.74% with -41.5% drawdown
directions.reason: the low-amount signal decays too fast; turnover cannot be compressed without losing the edge

directions.name: Style persistence / chasing the prior year's winning style
directions.measured: in 4 of 6 years the prior year's strongest style ranked in the bottom half the next year; 2020 healthcare +86% -> 2021 -74.2%
directions.reason: style persistence does not exist in this market; styles may be diversified but not bet on

required_fields_in_prereg_on_match: which exception applies: new_data or new_mechanism
citation of the original falsification id (BAN-xx)
what the original falsification could not have seen
